item.title: Figure It 1.0.0
item.description: • 22 new figures: VSEPR shapes, electrochemical cells, rate law and equilibrium graphs, phase diagrams, bond energy curves, chromatography, electric and magnetic fields, circular motion, torque, levers, pendulums, springs, roller coasters, cladograms, tree diagrams, scatter and dot plots, normal curves, tables of values, nets and segment addition. Type a cladogram's own tree and a tree diagram's probabilities.
